judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` / `SessionSummaryFrame` with field `sessions`) instead of the issue's specified `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` / `ConversationSummary` with field `conversations`. It also directly violates major requirements and acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag, omits the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code and `StoreCannotList`, and returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is missing instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error as explicitly required. Furthermore, validation allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (the ticket requires rejecting 0 and 201), logs `error.message` on store failure (violating the requirement not to log store details), leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the repo, and skips updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`. On the positive side, it dispatches off the per-session lock, enforces `session.userId` over any frame-supplied `userId`, and validates composite `before` cursors.
